M1704 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, private-holdout evidence, or level3 self-ID

stop_condition: stop if design would execute the full 10368-cell matrix
stop if design drops required controller controls
stop if design ranks profiles instead of auditing task quality

route to matrix pruning repair if smoke scale is still too large

allowed_updates: M1704 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up bounded smoke preflight or execution design manifest
next_stage_criteria: bounded smoke subset protocol is specified
controller-ranking and profile-tuning shortcuts remain blocked

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1704 is design-only and cannot prove history necessity.

allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded diagnostic calibration smoke can be designed from M1702 to test whether calibration axes reduce off-track dominance without ranking controllers.
success_criteria: bounded smoke scale is explicitly smaller than the full 10368-cell matrix
task-quality metrics and outcome buckets are specified
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design routes directly to full 10368-cell rollout
design tunes profiles or ranks controllers
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
decision_rule: M1704 passes if it designs a bounded diagnostic calibration smoke that preserves controls and avoids controller ranking.
